title: Introduce geofence-based KMS routing and audit throttle policy
author: Aisha Patel
release_notes: Adds configurable geofence-based KMS routing to enforce data-residency, introduces an audit-throttle policy to reduce noisy tenant logs, updates RBAC predicates to include region attributes, and migration notes for Private deployments.
description: Motivation: Customers operating under regional compliance constraints require stronger enforcement that keys and audit records originate and remain within permitted geofenced territories. This change introduces a geofence-aware KMS routing policy and a complementary audit-throttle mechanism to prevent high-frequency tenants from overwhelming audit pipelines while preserving fidelity for policy-critical events. Scope: - Geofence KMS routing: new policy artifact and runtime evaluator that pins KMS selection to a per-tenant geofence, with a deterministic fallback if the preferred key region is unavailable. - Audit throttle: configurable rate-based sampler for non-critical audit events, with deterministic sampling for security-sensitive traces (key ops, access denials). - RBAC adjustments: RBAC v2 policy predicates extended to evaluate request.region and request.geofence attributes. - Observability & tests: dashboards and unit/integration tests verifying geofence enforcement, fallback correctness, and audit sample fidelity. Backward compatibility: default behavior preserves current key-routing for tenants without geofence settings. Operator upgrade notes included for Dedicated and Private deployments. Design highlights: - Policy layer is policy-first (YAML) and evaluated in the control plane; decisions are signed and attached to requests for on-host enforcement. - Runtime routing uses a prioritized list: tenant-geofence KMS -> region-affine customer-managed KMS -> hosted fallback (with audit marker). - Audit-throttle has a two-tier policy: global rate caps per-tenant and event-class overrides (e.g., KMS:sign, KMS:decrypt always sampled). Implementation details: - New config: config/policies/geofence_kms.yaml defines geofence polygons and KMS affinity tags. - Evaluator: redwood/src/security/geofence_evaluator.go implements point-in-polygon checks with caching and lock-free reads. - Routing: redwood/src/serving/kms_router.go integrates policy decisions into the existing KMS selection pipeline and emits audit markers for fallbacks. - Audit: redwood/src/audit/throttle.go implements token-bucket per-tenant with persistent counters backed by Redis and a safe-mode that bypasses throttle for high-severity events. - RBAC: redwood/src/rbac/v2/predicate_region.go adds region/geofence predicates and a test harness that replays recorded requests. Tests & validation: - Unit tests for evaluator edge cases (equator-crossing polygons, small islands) and routing fallback. - Integration tests in perf-canary that run KMS routing under load and verify latency SLOs. - Security scan and policy lint added to CI. Operational notes: - New migrations: a small DB migration to add tenant.geofence_id and tenant.kms_affinity fields. - Rollout plan: staged rollout with feature flag gated by account; canary on Dedicated, followed by opt-in for Private installs via the installer. - Logging: new audit tag "kms_geofence" appears on audited KMS calls. This PR bundles code, policies, tests, and docs updates.

review_comments: Marco Rivera: Can we ensure the point-in-polygon algorithm is safe on malformed input? Also request explicit unit tests for edge-case coordinates.
Aisha Patel: Added sanitizer and added tests for malformed / out-of-range coordinates in commit f9a8b21.
Leah Kim: Concern about Redis counter hot keys for very large tenants — suggest sharding or a fallback to in-process leaky-bucket for short bursts.
Aisha Patel: Implemented per-tenant sharding heuristic and safe fallback to in-process bucket for <5s bursts. See throttle.go changes.
approvals: SRE Team: approved with note to monitor Redis saturation
merge_outcome: Merged by Marco Rivera after approvals. Feature gated and rolled to canary. No post-merge hotfix required.
operator_upgrade_instructions: Add tenant.geofence_id and tenant.kms_affinity via infra/migrations/20260215_add_tenant_geofence.sql. For Private installs run the installer with --enable-geofence-kms flag to enable policy evaluation services. Dedicated customers should coordinate with SRE for canary window.
observability_changes: Dashboard: Security -> KMS routing shows metric kms_geofence_fallback_total and audit_throttle_sample_rate_per_tenant. Alert: high rate of kms_geofence_fallback_total (>5% sustained) triggers SRE pager.
notes_for_release_manager: This ships behind a feature flag. Ops must ensure Redis capacity before enabling for accounts expected to exceed 50k events/min. Coordinate with Compliance for tenants with strict residency requirements.
